primitives.name: Trust-Safe Media Path
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSE is proprietary and complex, so every major item needs an immediate explanation, a next action, and a trust-safe media or visual path.
primitives.assumptions: Media path must be verifiable, non-intrusive, and aligned with user trust model.
primitives.breakdown_regime: P ∉ {video, image, table} implies invalid path.

layer2.mapping: Trust-safe media path P is derived from E and A such that P ∈ {video, image, table} and E ⊕ A → P.
layer2.telemetry: Media load success rate and user interaction metrics.

The motion explainer kernel acts as a temporal filter, ensuring that user intent is resolved within 10 seconds. This is modeled as a state transition system where each card state S evolves into a trust-safe media path P through an explanation E and action A. The dual nature of this system lies in its ability to balance internal product clarity (for teams) and external user value (for end-users). The failure mode arises when media paths lack trustworthiness or when explanations exceed the 10s threshold. The system’s robustness depends on empirical telemetry such as dwell time and media load success rates.
